_about: Read by tools/update_screenshots.py (run every hour by .github/workflows/screenshots.yml). The screenshots, their order and their descriptions come from each app's README; 'labels' are the short words under each thumbnail, by screenshot name (docs/screenshot-NAME.png, or docs/screenshot.png: 'screenshot'). A screenshot not listed gets a label made from its name: add it here to choose a better one.
